values.meaning: Damage amplification vs champions/monsters based on target's missing health, capped at 75% missing health
values.quote: {{ccs|increased|magic}} by {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 75 for 11|0 to 75|formula=7.5% per 7.5% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 75% '''missing''' health|color=health}}
values.binNote: SeraphineQ.DamageAmp = 75 matches the wiki's 75% cap; the 7.5% per 7.5% missing health scaling formula is tooltip text, not separately visible in the sheet's listed rows.

values.meaning: Expansion duration of the soundwave's area of effect
values.quote: upon arrival expands in a radius over {{fd|0.4}} seconds
values.binNote: No SeraphineQ row lists this timing; it appears only as wikitext description text, likely governed by a VFX/animation resource not present in the data sheet.

mechanics.claim: The soundwave's area of effect covers the zone via expansion in seven distinct rings and each target can only be hit once.
mechanics.quote: The area of effect is covered via expansion in seven distinct rings and targets can only be hit once.

mechanics.claim: High Note fires from wherever Seraphine is at the end of the cast time, and its impact delay depends on missile travel speed after that.
mechanics.quote: ''High Note'' will fire from wherever ''Seraphine'' is at the end of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: The maximum damage of High Note (against low-health targets) is treated as a cosmetic critical strike.
mechanics.quote: The maximum damage of ''High Note'' uses a {{ccs|cosmetic critical strike|magic|tip=false|link=true}}.
